notes.title: [UPDATE] Power-ups, Trading Cards and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1][Added][/h1]

- [b]Steam trading cards[/b] 
- [b]8 Power-ups:[/b]

* Defense - Adds 5 points to defense of warriors and witches
* Exhauster - Will cooldown 1 card of each player
* Heal - Adds 5 points to hero's life
* Hitman - Adds 5 hit points to each of your card, except witches
* Instant move - Allows you to do instant attack - you need to have attacking card on the turn position. 
* Rage - Does a rage-attack on all of your opponents - you need to have attacking card on the turn position
* Reveal - Shows all opponents turn cards
* Stamina - Adds 5 points to hero's stamina

[h1][Bug Fixes][/h1]

- [b]Fixed multiplayer/singleplayer bugs of particles and card order[/b]
- [b]Fixed cards' defence values[/b]
